title: Twenty-Four Chairs After All  (Veinticuatro sillas al final)

segments.t: A las seis menos cuarto, bajo la suave luz de los faroles del patio, Hannah y Caleb colocan las tazas de té cuando Arthur regresa corriendo desde el portón abierto con los ojos como platos. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Hannah! Caleb! Come look at the sidewalk outside our gate!
It is only a quarter to six. Are people arriving already?!
The bookstore owner, the pharmacist, the baker's cousin, and twelve neighbors!
All twelve chairs inside Room Nine just filled up in three minutes!
Wait, what about those extra twelve folding chairs under the courtyard arch?!
The ones I ordered by mistake on Saturday?!
Unfold all twelve around the four outdoor courtyard tables right now!
Every single one of your twenty-four bargain chairs has a guest, Arthur!
Did you hear that, Hannah?! My mistake was actually a brilliant business plan!
Take the bow, Arthur, and hand out the menu cards with a smile!
Open the arched windows wide so everyone under the tree hears the piano!
Welcome, friends, welcome! Hot mint tea is coming right out!
Veamos en detalle cómo el pedido equivocado de Arthur se transforma en un triunfo.
Hannah! Caleb! Come look at the sidewalk outside our gate!
'¡Hannah! ¡Caleb! ¡Vengan a mirar la acera afuera de nuestro portón!'
It is only a quarter to six. Are people arriving already?!
'Solo son las seis menos cuarto. ¿¡Ya está llegando gente!?'
The bookstore owner, the pharmacist, the baker's cousin, and twelve neighbors!
'¡El dueño de la librería, el farmacéutico, el primo del panadero y doce vecinos!'
All twelve chairs inside Room Nine just filled up in three minutes!
'¡Las doce sillas dentro de la habitación nueve acaban de llenarse en tres minutos!'
Wait, what about those extra twelve folding chairs under the courtyard arch?!
'Espera, ¿¡y esas doce sillas plegables extra bajo el arco del patio!?'
The ones I ordered by mistake on Saturday?!
'¿¡Las que pedí por error el sábado!?'
Unfold all twelve around the four outdoor courtyard tables right now!
'¡Desplieguen las doce alrededor de las cuatro mesas exteriores del patio ahora mismo!'
Every single one of your twenty-four bargain chairs has a guest, Arthur!
'¡Absolutamente cada una de tus veinticuatro sillas de oferta tiene un invitado, Arthur!'
Did you hear that, Hannah?! My mistake was actually a brilliant business plan!
'¿¡Oíste eso, Hannah!? ¡Mi error fue en realidad un plan de negocios brillante!'
Take the bow, Arthur, and hand out the menu cards with a smile!
'¡Haz la reverencia, Arthur, y reparte las tarjetas del menú con una sonrisa!'
Open the arched windows wide so everyone under the tree hears the piano!
'¡Abran bien las ventanas en arco para que todos bajo el árbol escuchen el piano!'
Welcome, friends, welcome! Hot mint tea is coming right out!
'¡Bienvenidos, amigos, bienvenidos! ¡El té caliente de menta sale enseguida!'
Volvamos a escuchar la escena completa.

The bookstore owner, the pharmacist, the baker's cousin, and twelve neighbors!
All twelve chairs inside Room Nine just filled up in three minutes!
Wait, what about those extra twelve folding chairs under the courtyard arch?!
The ones I ordered by mistake on Saturday?!
Unfold all twelve around the four outdoor courtyard tables right now!
Every single one of your twenty-four bargain chairs has a guest, Arthur!
Did you hear that, Hannah?! My mistake was actually a brilliant business plan!
Take the bow, Arthur, and hand out the menu cards with a smile!
Open the arched windows wide so everyone under the tree hears the piano!
Welcome, friends, welcome! Hot mint tea is coming right out!
¡Ni una sola de las veinticuatro sillas encargadas por Arthur se queda vacía bajo los faroles! Nos vemos en la próxima escena.
See you later!
